name: Survey tile in Gemini
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Gemini, imaged by SPHEREx 26 times in 9 visits over 73 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 52 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.1 days starting 2026-03-30, at wavelengths from 0.79 to 4.96 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
